'''Taryish Juhden''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who spent time in [[Niima Outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Jakku]] around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. While at the outpost he encountered the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] several times, and watched her fend off two [[Unkar's thugs|thugs]] working for [[Unkar Plutt]] as they tried to steal the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]]. He later fled when Niima was [[Escape from Jakku|attacked]] by the forces of the [[First Order]], running past [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] firing on civilians.

==Biography==
[[File:Taryish_flees.png|thumb|left|200px|Taryish fled from stormtroopers at Niima.]]
Taryish Juhden<ref name="DI3.0">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> who was present in [[Niima Outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Jakku]]<ref name="TFA" /> around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TFAVD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> He was present in [[Niima Outpost]] when the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] arrived alone on her [[Rey's speeder|speeder]] shortly after the [[First Order]]'s [[Attack on Tuanul|attack]] on the nearby [[Tuanul]] village, and walked past her and the scavenger [[Roodown]] as Rey dismounted.<ref name="TFA" />

He was then present again the next day and was amongst a group whom the First Order deserter [[Finn]] approached in search of [[water]]. Another of the group shooed Finn away, forcing him to drink from a [[happabore]] trough. Both Juhden and Finn were later amongst a group who gathered to watch Rey fight off two [[Unkar's thugs|thugs]] working for the [[junk dealer]] [[Unkar Plutt]], who ran Niima. Rey's attackers attempted to steal the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]] from the scavenger, but she managed to successfully fight them both off with her [[quarterstaff]]. Shortly after the confrontation the First Order [[Escape from Jakku|attacked]] Niima in search of the BB-8. During the fighting Juhden sprinted behind a trio of [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] who were firing at Rey and the First Order deserter [[Finn]], as well as various bystanders.<ref name="TFA" />

==Personality and traits==
Juhden was a fair-skinned [[human]] [[Gender|male]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Equipment==
While in Niima, Juhden wore a light [[Color|brown]] [[Clothing|robe]], a pair of green-lensed [[goggles]] and a large headwrap.<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Taryish_Juhden_disney.png|thumb|right|200px|Juhden appeared in Disney Infinity.]]
{{Quote|These stupid mouse droids are so hard to control! I'd put restraining bolts on them if I could catch them.|Juhden's non-canon dialogue from Disney Infinity 3.0|<ref name="Disney Infinity 3.0">''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''</ref>}}
Taryish Juhden was played by an uncredited extra in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], which was released in [[2015]].<ref name="TFA" /> The character was not named in the film, but was identified in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]'', which was released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="DI3.0" /> Despite the game being non-[[canon]], story group member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that the names provided by the game for previously unidentified characters, including Juhden, were considered canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/749616406245699584|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-07-03|quote=@LelalMekha Yeah, same with Infinity.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-LegoName-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: "@pablohidalgo <nowiki>youtube.com/watch?v=JwxAeHPLpPg</nowiki> The Lego game identifies a few BG characters from TFA, but are those names canonical?"}}</ref> In the game he takes part in the mission "Bolt of Inspiration", where he offers to pay the player in scrap if they can round up several [[MSE-series]] mouse [[droid]]s that are loose in Niima and bring them to him so he can put restraining bolts on them.<ref name="DI3.0" />
